post.summary: Control life-cycle and workflow of the deployed workload
post.description: Used to control life-cycle and workflow of the deployed workload. With this request the command is only sent to OVDM, the result of the operation is received via mqtt.

schema.description: Request body for controlling the life-cycle and workflow of the deployed workload

removeImages.description:
Specifies whether Docker and Docker Compose images associated with the deployed workload
should be removed during the undeploy process.
- If set to **true**, all images linked to the workload will be deleted from the system.
- If set to **false**, the images will be retained.
This setting applies specifically to workloads using the Management System Registry.

status.description: The current state of DNA configuration

fileName.description: The name of the DNA configuration file (target configuration)

progress.description: The progress of DNA node configuration

message.description: More detail about the current step in the configuration process

updated.description: Date and time in ISO 8601 format

user.description: The name of the user who did the last change

initiatedFrom.description: The application from which the DNA configuration was done

signed.description: Indicates whether the DNA file was signed by the Management System prior to sending the apply request to the node.

integrity.description: Object representing the result of a workload integrity check, including whether the check passed and when it was executed

status.description:
Workload integrity check status.
  - valid: Integrity check passed.
  - invalid: Integrity check failed.
  - unknown: Integrity could not be determined. No reference hash exists to validate against (e.g., legacy DNA, or failed hash calculation).
  - not_applicable: Integrity check does not apply in this state (e.g., DNA is not applied at all).
  - unavailable: Integrity status is unavailable or unreliable, such as during DNA reconfiguration or cancellation.

checkedAt.description: The time indicating when the workload integrity check was performed

signature.description:
DNA file signature verification result. values:
  - valid: The signature was successfully verified.
  - invalid: Signature verification failed. Possible reasons: signature file missing, corrupted, or an error occurred during verification (e.g., failed to download public key or a read error).
  - skipped: Signature verification was not performed because it was not applicable (DNA file is not signed at all).

serviceName.description: The name of the service to which the configuration refers. The service name is extracted from the docker-compose file. Service name can only contain numbers, letters,_ and -.

restartOnConfigurationUpdate.description: Indicates whether the docker container should be restarted on configuration update or not

containerPath.description: The path in the container where the volume is mounted
